name: Klein Constantia
tagline: Rooted in Tradition. Crafted in Precision.
description: One of the world's most beautiful vineyards, dating back to 1685. Home of the legendary Vin de Constance, favoured by Napoleon, Jane Austen, and Charles Dickens. A WWF Conservation Champion producing world-class wines on the slopes of the Constantiaberg.

items.name: Vin de Constance Tasting
items.description: The iconic sweet wine revival. A taste of history in the distinctive replica hand-blown bottle.

items.name: Estate Range Tasting
items.description: Sauvignon Blanc, Chardonnay, and red blends from our decomposed granite soils.

items.name: Premium Heritage Tasting
items.description: Limited releases and library wines. Includes Vin de Constance and rare vintages.

items.name: Vin de Constance
items.description: 2007 vintage rated 97 pts — highest-rated SA sweet wine ever. Napoleon's deathbed glass.

items.name: Estate Sauvignon Blanc
items.description: Crisp, terroir-driven white from ocean-cooled slopes.

items.name: Estate Chardonnay
items.description: Elegant, barrel-fermented Chardonnay with mineral precision.

items.name: Estate Red Blend
items.description: Classic Bordeaux-style blend from Constantia's finest blocks.

items.name: Vineyard Tour
items.description: Walk through 146 hectares of heritage vines with our winemaking team.

items.name: Cellar Tour & Tasting
items.description: Behind-the-scenes cellar experience with barrel tastings.

items.name: Private Event Hire
items.description: Host your event in one of the Cape's most historic settings.

testimonials.text: One of the world's most beautiful vineyards.
testimonials.author: Wine Spectator
